Faq.pageSubtitle: Everything you need to know about booking, payments, and our service standards.

1.q: How do I book a transfer?
1.a: Select your pickup and drop-off locations, choose your vehicle, date and time, then complete the booking form. You'll receive an e-Voucher with QR code instantly.

2.q: Can I book multiple routes in one booking?
2.a: Yes. Our booking system supports one-way, round-trip, multi-route, multi-day, and charter bookings — all in a single reservation.

3.q: What if my flight is delayed?
3.a: We monitor flight schedules. For airport pickups, we include 60 minutes of free waiting time from your actual landing time.

4.q: What payment methods do you accept?
4.a: We accept bank transfer, credit/debit cards, and PromptPay during online booking (demo uses mock payment data). You can also pay the driver in cash (THB) if arranged in advance.

5.a: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before pickup. Cancellations within 24 hours may incur a 50% charge. No-shows are non-refundable.

6.a: Yes, child seats are available upon request at no extra charge. Please specify the age/weight of children when booking.

7.a: Yes. Quoted prices include tolls, parking, fuel, and driver service. Extra charges only apply for overtime waiting or optional add-ons you request.

8.q: How do I receive my e-Voucher?
8.a: After confirming your booking, an e-Voucher with QR code is shown instantly and can be reopened anytime from your booking page. Show it to the driver at pickup.

waiting.title: Waiting Time
waiting.content: Airport pickups include 60 minutes free waiting. Hotel/pier pickups include 15 minutes free waiting. Additional waiting is charged at 200 THB per 30 minutes.

flight-delay.title: Flight Delay
flight-delay.content: We track your flight number and adjust pickup time automatically. No extra charge for delays up to 2 hours.

child-seat.title: Child Seat
child-seat.content: Infant, toddler, and booster seats available free of charge. Request during booking.

pets.title: Pets
pets.content: Small pets in carriers are welcome in SUV and Van categories. Additional cleaning fee of 300 THB may apply.

ferry.title: Ferry Connections
ferry.content: Pier transfers include drop-off at the ferry terminal. Ferry tickets can be arranged as an add-on service.

toll.title: Toll & Parking
toll.content: All toll fees and parking charges at airports/piers are included in the quoted price.

payment.title: Payment
payment.content: Pay online via card/transfer or cash to driver in THB. Prices are all-inclusive unless stated otherwise.

cancellation.title: Cancellation
cancellation.content: Free cancellation 24+ hours before pickup. Within 24 hours: 50% charge. No-show: no refund.

refund.title: Refund
refund.content: Approved refunds are processed within 5–7 business days to the original payment method.

airport-transfer.title: Airport Transfer
airport-transfer.subtitle: Private transfers to and from Krabi and Southern Thailand airports
airport-transfer.intro: Flight-timed pickups with meet & greet options, luggage space, and direct rides to hotels, beaches, and piers.
airport-transfer.tip: Share your flight number when booking. Krabi Airport meeting points: domestic Door 15, international Door 16 — look left after you exit.
airport-transfer.benefit1: Flight monitoring and flexible waiting time
airport-transfer.benefit2: Meet & greet at arrivals on request
airport-transfer.benefit3: Space for suitcases — sedan to van options

1.q: What if my flight is delayed?
1.a: We monitor flights for airport pickups and include about 60 minutes of free waiting from your actual landing time.

2.a: Yes. Add your flight number when booking. At Krabi Airport, domestic arrivals exit Door 15 and international arrivals exit Door 16, then look left — the driver waits with your name on a sign.

3.q: How much luggage can I bring?
3.a: Economy sedans fit about 3 medium bags. For more luggage or a family, choose SUV, van, or VIP van on the booking form.

4.q: Can you pick up at Phuket Airport too?
4.a: Yes. We cover Krabi (KBV) and selected Southern Thailand airports including Phuket, with private point-to-point fares.

5.q: How do I pay for airport transfer?
5.a: Pay online by bank transfer, card, or PromptPay when you book. Cash to the driver can be arranged in advance if needed.

6.q: When do I get driver details?
6.a: Driver name, phone, and car details are shared before pickup — usually within 24 hours of your transfer time.

hotel-transfer.title: Hotel Transfer
hotel-transfer.subtitle: Door-to-door rides between resorts, hotels, and key Krabi spots
hotel-transfer.intro: Private car to your hotel lobby or villa gate — no shared vans, no extra stops.
hotel-transfer.tip: Add your hotel name or pin in the booking notes for smoother drop-off.
hotel-transfer.benefit2: Ideal for late check-ins and early departures
hotel-transfer.benefit3: Premium and VIP options for special stays

1.q: Will you drop me at the hotel lobby?
1.a: Yes. Transfers are door-to-door to the lobby or villa gate. Add the hotel name or map pin in your booking notes.

2.q: Can I book a late-night hotel pickup?
2.a: Yes. Private transfers run for early departures and late check-ins — choose your date and time when you book.

3.a: No. Every booking is a private car for your group only, with no extra hotel stops.

4.q: Which vehicle is best for a resort stay?
4.a: Premium sedan or Signature Class suits couples; VIP van is ideal for families and extra luggage.

5.q: Can I change the hotel drop-off after booking?
5.a: Yes, if the new hotel is nearby. Message us on LINE with your booking number as early as possible.

6.q: Do you wait if check-in is delayed?
6.a: Short waits at the hotel are fine. For longer delays, tell us on LINE so the driver can adjust.

pier-transfer.title: Pier Transfer
pier-transfer.subtitle: Reliable connections to ferry and speedboat piers
pier-transfer.intro: Arrive on time for Phi Phi, Railay, and island departures with drivers who know pier schedules.
pier-transfer.tip: Book at least 45–60 minutes before ferry departure from Ao Nang or town.
pier-transfer.benefit1: Timed to boat and ferry departures
pier-transfer.benefit2: Help with bags to the pier entrance
pier-transfer.benefit3: Links from airport, hotel, or beach

1.q: How early should I arrive before the ferry?
1.a: Plan to reach the pier 45–60 minutes before departure from Ao Nang or Krabi Town, especially in peak season.

2.q: Can the driver help with bags at the pier?
2.a: Yes. Drivers assist with luggage to the pier entrance so you can check in for your boat more easily.

3.q: Do you connect to Phi Phi and Railay boats?
3.a: Yes. Popular drops include Ao Nang Pier and links toward Phi Phi and Railay boat services.

4.q: Where can I check boat times?
4.a: See our Boat Schedules page for sample ferry and speedboat times, then book your pier transfer to match.

5.q: What if my boat is cancelled?
5.a: Contact us right away. We can reschedule the transfer or help adjust the drop-off when boat operators change times.

6.q: Can I book hotel → pier → hotel the same day?
6.a: Yes. Add both legs in one booking as multi-route, or book two one-way transfers with matching times.

beach-transfer.title: Beach Transfer
beach-transfer.subtitle: Direct rides to Ao Nang, Railay, Patong, and coastal areas
beach-transfer.intro: Skip taxis at the curb — go straight from airport or hotel to the beach with a fixed private fare.
beach-transfer.tip: Railay access may include a short boat hop from the pier; ask us when you book.
beach-transfer.benefit1: Fixed private fare, no meter surprises

1.q: Is the fare fixed to the beach?
1.a: Yes. Private beach transfers use a fixed fare for your vehicle — no meter surprises at the curb.

2.q: How do I get to Railay Beach?
2.a: Most guests ride to the Railay pier area, then take a short shared longtail. Tell us when you book if you need pier timing help.

3.q: Can you drop at beach resorts?
3.a: Yes. We drop at beachfront hotels and agreed beach access points across Ao Nang, Railay links, and coastal areas.

4.q: What if I have kids and lots of bags?
4.a: Choose SUV or van for extra space. Child seats can be requested in advance via booking notes or LINE.

5.q: Do you go to quieter beaches as well?
5.a: Yes, where road access allows. Add the beach or resort name in notes and we’ll confirm the best drop-off point.

6.q: Is round-trip to the beach cheaper?
6.a: Round-trip bookings include a small discount versus two separate one-ways. Use the price checker to compare.

city-transfer.title: City Transfer
city-transfer.subtitle: Comfortable rides between towns across Southern Thailand
city-transfer.intro: Krabi Town, Trang, Surat Thani, and more — private cars for errands, hotels, and day moves.
city-transfer.tip: For multi-stop city runs, note each stop in booking comments.
city-transfer.benefit2: Air-conditioned comfort for longer city hops
city-transfer.benefit3: Sedan to van for families and luggage

1.q: Can I make multiple stops in town?
1.a: Yes, on request. List each stop in the booking notes so we can plan time and quote fairly.

2.q: Do you cover Trang and Surat Thani?
2.a: Yes. City and town transfers include Krabi Town plus selected Southern cities for private point-to-point trips.

3.a: All transfer vehicles are air-conditioned and suitable for daytime heat and longer town hops.

4.q: Can I book same-day in the city?
4.a: Often yes, subject to availability. Book online as early as you can, or message us on LINE for urgent trips.

5.q: Can I keep the car for a few hours in town?
5.a: For waiting or hourly use, choose hourly charter or note wait time when you book so we can quote correctly.

6.q: Do you pick up from bus or train stations?
6.a: Yes, where listed in our locations. Select the station as pickup or drop-off on the booking form.

attraction-transfer.title: Attraction Transfer
attraction-transfer.subtitle: Temples, emerald pools, hot springs, and viewpoint runs
attraction-transfer.intro: Private transfers to Krabi’s top sights with wait-and-return options for day trips.
attraction-transfer.tip: Ask for wait-and-return if you want the same car for the trip back.
attraction-transfer.benefit3: Vans for small groups and tour gear

1.q: Can the driver wait while we visit?
1.a: Yes. Ask for wait-and-return when you book so the same car can take you back after Emerald Pool, temples, or hot springs.

2.a: Popular drops include Emerald Pool, Tiger Cave Temple, hot springs, and other Krabi parks and viewpoints.

3.q: Is a van better for a day of sightseeing?
3.a: For 4+ guests or wet clothes after swimming, a van or VIP van is more comfortable than a sedan.

4.q: Do entrance tickets come with the transfer?
4.a: No. Transfer fares cover transport only. Park and temple tickets are paid on site unless you book a separate tour.

5.q: Can we visit more than one attraction?
5.a: Yes. List the order of stops in booking notes, or book a multi-route / day charter for a full sightseeing loop.

6.q: What time should we leave for morning sights?
6.a: For popular spots like Emerald Pool, an early start helps avoid heat and crowds — we can suggest a pickup time when you book.

inter-province-transfer.title: Inter Province Transfer
inter-province-transfer.subtitle: Long-distance private transfers across Southern Thailand
inter-province-transfer.intro: Krabi–Phuket, Trang, Surat Thani and beyond — private SUV, van, or bus for comfortable highway travel.
inter-province-transfer.tip: Long routes book out on weekends — reserve early for morning departures.
inter-province-transfer.benefit1: Highway-ready SUV, van, and bus options
inter-province-transfer.benefit3: Ideal for groups with luggage and gear

1.q: Which vehicle is best for long highway trips?
1.a: SUV or van for comfort; VIP van or bus for larger groups and more luggage on Krabi–Phuket or Surat routes.

2.q: Is the price fixed between provinces?
2.a: Yes. Inter-province transfers use a private fixed fare for your chosen vehicle, agreed before you pay.

3.q: How early should I book weekend trips?
3.a: Weekends and holidays fill up early — reserve morning departures at least a day ahead when you can.

4.a: Quoted transfer prices include standard tolls and parking related to the trip unless noted otherwise at booking.

5.q: Are rest stops included on long routes?
5.a: Drivers can stop briefly for toilets or snacks on long highway trips. Mention preferred breaks in your notes.

6.q: Can you do Krabi to Phuket with hotel drop-off?
6.a: Yes. Choose your Phuket hotel or airport as the drop-off — private point-to-point, not a shared bus.

krabi-airport-transfer-guide.title: Krabi Airport Transfer Guide: Smooth Arrival at KBV
krabi-airport-transfer-guide.excerpt: What to expect after landing at Krabi International Airport, how meet & greet works, and how to book a private transfer with an e-Voucher.
krabi-airport-transfer-guide.p1: Landing at Krabi International Airport (KBV) is the start of your Southern Thailand trip. A private airport transfer helps you skip taxi queues and go straight to your hotel, beach, or pier.
krabi-airport-transfer-guide.p2: With Krabi Links Taxi, your driver tracks the flight and includes free waiting time for airport pickups. You receive an e-Voucher with a QR code right after booking — show it at the meeting point.
krabi-airport-transfer-guide.p3: Popular routes from KBV include Ao Nang Beach, Railay, Centara Grand, and Krabi Town. Choose Economy Sedan for couples or a Van if you travel with family and luggage.
krabi-airport-transfer-guide.p4: Tip: Share your flight number and hotel name when booking so the driver can prepare a name sign and plan the best route around evening traffic.

ao-nang-railay-beach-transfer.title: Ao Nang & Railay Beach Transfer Tips
ao-nang-railay-beach-transfer.excerpt: How to move between Ao Nang, Railay, and nearby resorts with private cars, piers, and the right vehicle for beach bags.
ao-nang-railay-beach-transfer.p1: Ao Nang is the hub for many Krabi beach stays, while Railay is reached via short pier connections. Planning your transfer in advance keeps the day simple.
ao-nang-railay-beach-transfer.p2: From the airport or Krabi Town, book a private drop-off to Ao Nang Beach or your hotel. For Railay, we can take you to the pier and help time your boat connection.
ao-nang-railay-beach-transfer.p3: If you carry snorkel gear or large bags, an SUV or Standard Van gives more space than a sedan. Round-trip bookings also save time on checkout day.
ao-nang-railay-beach-transfer.p4: Evening returns from the beach can get busy — reserve your pickup time early, especially on weekends and public holidays.

pier-transfer-to-phi-phi.title: Pier Transfer to Phi Phi: What Travelers Should Know
pier-transfer-to-phi-phi.excerpt: A practical checklist for hotel-to-pier transfers, ferry timing, and luggage tips before heading to Phi Phi.
pier-transfer-to-phi-phi.p1: Island days start on land. A reliable pier transfer from your hotel or the airport means you reach Ao Nang Pier or other departure points without rushing.
pier-transfer-to-phi-phi.p2: Build in buffer time for check-in and boarding. We recommend arriving at the pier at least 45–60 minutes before ferry departure during peak season.
pier-transfer-to-phi-phi.p3: Private vans are ideal for groups sharing the same ferry. Families can request child seats free of charge when booking.
pier-transfer-to-phi-phi.p4: After your island trip, book a return pier pickup so a driver is ready when the boat docks — especially useful if you arrive after dark.

krabi-to-phuket-inter-province.title: Krabi to Phuket Inter-Province Transfer
krabi-to-phuket-inter-province.excerpt: Compare comfort and timing for the Krabi–Phuket corridor, vehicle options, and when a private transfer beats shared vans.
krabi-to-phuket-inter-province.p1: The Krabi–Phuket route is one of the most requested inter-province transfers in Southern Thailand. Private cars give door-to-door timing without multiple stops.
krabi-to-phuket-inter-province.p2: Typical journeys connect KBV or Krabi Town with Phuket Airport or Patong. Travel time depends on traffic and whether you start from the airport or town.
krabi-to-phuket-inter-province.p3: For longer rides, VIP Van or Mini Bus options offer more space and comfort. Prices are all-inclusive of tolls and parking unless you add waiting time.
krabi-to-phuket-inter-province.p4: Book round-trip if you fly into one province and out of the other — one reservation covers both legs with a single e-Voucher flow.
